origin.description: Find non-ASCII lines in a file.
origin.details: readLines(file, warn = FALSE) passed to showNonASCII.

translation.description: Find non-ASCII lines in a file.
translation.details: Reads the file as UTF-8 and passes the lines to show_non_ascii.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from tools import show_non_ascii_file
path = tempfile.mktemp()
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("café\nplain\n")
print(show_non_ascii_file(path))
